limits: Typed faults and synthetic whole contexts are distinct from earned gameplay and native faults.
Fresh real-file bootstrap destroys/recreates an owner in the same process; not OS kill/native/power-loss.
Existing raw unreadable slots with no journal retain prior startup behavior; this is not global corrupt-save protection.
No editor import performed; existing imported cache reused, new UIDs generated with actual headless ResourceUID API. Root owns packaging/editor/native acceptance.
No rendered readability/physical Fold7/clipboard/hardware-storage/live cloud acceptance.

Earlier passing runtime is retained with exact reconstructable summary sentence plus subsequent read/resolve/persist marker-admission delta; final focused marker/fault/edge/worker/input receipts bind current runtime.

Any existing invalid, unreadable or conflicting marker blocks active writes. A persistently torn marker cannot be repaired by Retry alone; validated in-memory choices remain exportable; cold unreadable-marker startup offers retry-read/local-retention explanation, without copy enumeration. No automatic deletion/default adoption.
Marker/fault/edge/worker/input packets precede only the exactly reconstructed two-line active-legacy phase guidance override; final7/0 phase packet binds full current runtime.
